name: faqs-3
title: FAQs 3
description: We have compiled answers to the questions our support team receives most frequently.

files.content:
--- import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/accordion" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Section, SectionContainer, SectionTitle, } from "@/components/ui/section" type Props = HTMLAttributes<"section"> & { badge?: string title: string description: string faqs: { id: string question: string answer: string }[] } const { class: className, badge, title, description, faqs, ...props } = Astro.props ---
{badge && {badge}} {title}

{description}

{ faqs.map((item) => ( {item.question} {item.answer} )) }
